root_cause.controls: The only typesense-search-form element was nested inside the hidden .side-panel modal.
root_cause.blank_space: Phase 4C hid the legacy data-tab children but left #data-tab itself as a flex-filling container, pushing typesense-results-ui to the viewport bottom.
root_cause.test_gap: Phase 4C tests inspected source tokens and contract counts; they never ran a rendered browser or asserted visibility, geometry, placement, console errors, or network behavior.

authentication.result_queries: login required by existing runtime policy
authentication.ui_behavior: controls remain visible; clicking Tìm kiếm opens the login panel and shows a login-required result message

searchable.ui_route: group tab > Tất cả trường tìm kiếm or specific field > keyword input

filterable.ui_route: group tab > Bộ lọc và sắp xếp > metadata-derived text/date/numeric control

sortable.ui_route: group tab > Bộ lọc và sắp xếp > Sắp xếp theo + Thứ tự

autocomplete.ui_route: group tab > autocomplete-capable search field > keyword suggestions

validation.secret_scan: clean across the 9 recovery source, test, and audit files

known_limitations: No authorized browser session was available, so result rows, pagination, and expanded detail could not be validated against real data.
String multi-value filters use a compact comma-separated input because the contract does not publish finite option lists or a UI-control enum.
The built-in browser connector had no available browser; Chrome/Selenium supplied the rendered-browser evidence.
The WSL user service needed a temporary keepalive during validation; no repository runtime or data configuration changed.
